subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Do workflow/security owners accept the supplier-contract review and available CI as sufficient for these credential-bearing action updates, or require a redacted representative post-update workflow run before merge?
rationale: The branch changes third-party code executed with repository secrets and privileged workflow permissions; only a responsible human can decide whether the contract review and acceptable proof level meet the repository's supply-chain boundary.

options.title: Require representative workflow evidence
options.body: Run and retain redacted evidence from a representative updated workflow after completing direct supplier-contract checks, then refresh review.

options.title: Accept the pinned-update risk
options.body: A workflow/security owner may explicitly accept the immutable-pin update based on upstream review and CI without additional runtime evidence.

options.title: Pause the grouped refresh
options.body: Close or defer this Dependabot batch and take future action updates in narrower owner-reviewed groups.

recommendation.title: Require representative workflow evidence
recommendation.body: Run and retain redacted evidence from a representative updated workflow after completing direct supplier-contract checks, then refresh review.

likelyOwner.reason: This shared workflow surface spans secrets, registry publishing, security scanning, and agent automation rather than a single product module.
